mo_ta_cong_viec:
Unity Developer (WebGL)
Position: Unity Developer (WebGL)
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain a Unity WebGL application for desktop and mobile browsers.
Build interactive 3D features such as:
Camera navigation
Object selection and highlighting
Measurement tools
Section view / clipping
Timeline playback
Annotation and markup
Material and object visibility control
Optimize WebGL performance, loading time, and memory usage.
Implement Addressables or asset streaming solutions for large 3D projects.
Integrate REST APIs with backend services.
Work with cloud storage (AWS S3 or similar) for asset delivery.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers and backend developers.
Debug and resolve browser-specific issues across Chrome, Edge, Safari, and mobile devices.
Maintain clean, reusable, and scalable code.
yeu_cau:
Required Skills
2+ years of Unity development experience.
Strong knowledge of C#.
Experience building and deploying Unity WebGL applications.
Understanding of Unity rendering pipeline and performance optimization.
Experience with:
Addressables
Asset Bundles
UI Toolkit or Unity UI
Physics and raycasting
Animation and Timeline
Familiar with REST APIs and JSON.
Knowledge of Git version control.
Ability to profile and optimize CPU, GPU, and memory usage.
Nice to Have
Experience with Three.js or other WebGL-based JavaScript 3D frameworks.
Knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for WebGL integration.
Experience with Unity WebGL plugins (.jslib) and browser APIs.
Experience working with BIM, IFC, Revit, or Navisworks models.
Familiarity with AWS services (S3, CloudFront, EC2).
Experience optimizing large-scale 3D scenes for web browsers.
Knowledge of glTF/GLB formats and 3D asset pipelines.
Experience building construction, digital twin, or engineering visualization applications.
Familiarity with collaborative or multi-user web applications.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Good communication and teamwork abilities.
